WITH inv AS (SELECT rf.sku, rf.product_id, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS stock_on_hand, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' AND rf.period_end >= '2026-09-01' AND rf.period_end <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY rf.sku, rf.product_id) SELECT inv.sku, COALESCE(p.product_name_en, p.product_name_native) AS product_name, inv.stock_on_hand, inv.fact_count FROM inv LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.id = inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.sku LIMIT 100

WITH po AS (SELECT id FROM purchase_orders WHERE submitted_at >= '2026-09-01' AND submitted_at < '2026-10-01'), agg AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(i.line_total) AS amount, SUM(i.quantity) AS boxes, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM purchase_order_items AS i JOIN po ON po.id = i.po_id LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.category) SELECT category, amount, boxes, line_count, amount / SUM(amount) OVER () AS amount_share FROM agg ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 100

WITH sales AS (SELECT rf.sku, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS units_sold, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'units_sold' AND rf.period_start >= '2026-09-01' AND rf.period_end <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY rf.sku) SELECT p.sku, p.product_name_en, s.units_sold, s.fact_count FROM sales AS s LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.sku = s.sku ORDER BY s.units_sold DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT po_number, status, total_amount, eta_date FROM purchase_orders WHERE status <> 'completed' AND (submitted_at IS NULL OR submitted_at < '2026-10-01') ORDER BY po_number LIMIT 100
